strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and reverses. Enter at the price level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs, at the top of the grab candle after a sell-side sweep; for shorts, at the bottom of the grab candle after a buy-side sweep.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab wick/level. Take profit at the nearest recent swing level in the reversal direction: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples include daily, 15-minute, and 1-hour contexting

variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low
